scientific_integrity: General proof uses the cycle adjacency extremal eigenvalue, explicit optimal Gram matrix, exact integer cut count and algebraic endpoint inequalities. Finite tests are supporting checks only. Previously published unweighted-wheel numerical table values are acknowledged.
scientific_limitations: Uniform nonnegative spoke weights and unit rim weights only; basic GW SDP, not stronger relaxations; full Delorme--Poljak (1993) predecessor text not inspected; mathematical independent audit not performed.
title: Exact weighted-wheel Max-Cut relaxation and a nine-rim-vertex worst-gap switch
